_comment: THE nightly rota (GH #360). Which Macs run the 2 AM nightly, and when. Read by scripts/install_nightly.sh (the launchd time), scripts/nightly_guarded.sh (an off-rota Mac never runs), tools/publish_metrics.py (an off-rota Mac's rows leave the pass/fail table; the page shows it as 'off the rota', never as a failure) and scripts/morning_metrics.sh. Labels are the short host labels (RicksM4 -> M4).
